Good news — as a Thai citizen you can enter Vietnam visa-free for your 30-day trip.

1. Primary pathway: Visa-free entry under a bilateral Vietnam-Thailand agreement. No visa application needed.
2. Key details: The visa-free stay allows up to 30 days, and your planned stay is exactly 30 days, so you're right at the limit — make sure your entry and exit dates don't slip past that 30-day window, since there's no buffer.
3. E-Visa as fallback: If you'd like more flexibility (e.g., a longer stay or multiple entries), an e-Visa is available to all nationalities, including Thai citizens, for up to 90 days, costing USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), with 2-3 business day processing at evisa.gov.vn.
4. Data caveat: Make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date. This data is current as of 2026-08-17 — please verify the latest policy at https://evisa.gov.vn/ before you travel, since visa-free terms can change.
